changelog:
- Initial release of the ecommerce-reviews skill.
- Extracts customer reviews from any e-commerce product or reviews page (supports Amazon, WooCommerce, Shopify, and sites with standard review markup).
- Returns reviewer name, star rating, date, review title, review body, verified purchase status, and helpful votes.
- Supports pagination for multi-page review sections, including Amazon and generic platforms.
- All progress notifications follow the user's language.
- Includes error resumption, memory of past execution issues, and efficient batch orchestration.
